Drop Shape Analyzer - DSA100S - Krüss 
The premium instrument for wettability and cleanliness analyses for coatings and pretreated materials of all kind. Delivered and supported by Cromocol. 
Get a Quote
Advanced Drop Shape Analysis for Surface Science
The DSA100 Drop Shape Analyzer - DSA100S from Krüss presents a top-tier semi-automatic measurement solution for both static and dynamic contact angle analysis, crucial for scientific evaluation of wettability through surface free energy (SFE) determination. Its robust design makes it exceptionally suitable for reliable quality assurance of surface pre-treatment techniques and for the development and optimization of various wetting and coating processes. The instrument is enriched with accessories enabling ultra-fast one-click SFE measurement and specialized analysis at elevated temperatures, broadening the application range significantly.
Key application areas include optimizing activation processes like plasma, flame, or corona treatment before bonding or coating, understanding the wettability of various materials including plastics, glass, ceramics, and metals, evaluating the efficiency of hydrophobic and other types of coatings, analyzing surface cleanliness, and conducting wetting analysis under controlled temperatures.
DSA100S heralds advanced measuring methods, including contact angle measurements on solid surfaces and using a gas bubble, analyzing contact angles for two drops dosed in parallel, and determining the surface free energy of solids. The robust housing minimizes vibration impact, while software-controlled dosing ensures precision and reproducibility. The high-resolution camera and quality zoom lens work in tandem with the ADVANCE software for precise, user-independent results.

Frequently Asked Questions
 What are the key features of the Drop Shape Analyzer - DSA100S? 
 The DSA100S is a semi-automatic, advanced drop shape analyzer designed for both static and dynamic contact angle measurements to evaluate surface wettability through surface free energy determination. It features software-controlled dosing, a high-resolution camera, and a comprehensive suite of analysis options for reliable quality assurance and optimization of surface treatments and coatings. Accessories for one-click SFE measurement and high-temperature analysis expand its applicability further. What type of measurements can the DSA100S perform? 
 The DSA100S is capable of performing various measurements including static and dynamic contact angles, surface free energy of solids, pendant and rising drop analysis for surface and interfacial tension, and more. It utilizes advanced measuring methods such as analyzing contact angles with a gas bubble and for two drops dosed in parallel. Can the DSA100S be used for high-temperature applications? 
 Yes, the DSA100S has optional accessories enabling specialized analysis at elevated temperatures. This makes it suitable for a wide range of applications, including the evaluation of material wettability and the efficiency of coatings under controlled temperature conditions. What is the resolution and speed of the syringe dosing system in the DSA100S? 
 The syringe dosing system of the DSA100S offers a resolution of 20 nL and a dosing speed range of 0.004 to 25 µL/s. This precision ensures accurate and reproducible dosing for all measurements. How does the DSA100S ensure the accuracy and reproducibility of measurements? 
 The DSA100S incorporates a robust design to minimize vibrations, software-controlled dosing for precision liquid handling, and a high-resolution camera coupled with quality optics. These features, along with the advanced ADVANCE software, ensure precise, user-independent results that are both accurate and reproducible. Is the DSA100S compatible with various surface types for analysis? 
 Yes, the DSA100S is designed for the analysis of a wide range of materials, including plastics, glass, ceramics, and metals. It is highly versatile and can be used to understand the wettability of various surfaces, making it an ideal solution for industries that work with diverse materials. What software does the DSA100S use for analysis, and is it available in multiple languages? 
 The DSA100S utilizes the ADVANCE software for its operations, which supports a broad array of analysis modules and features. The software is available in multiple languages, including Chinese (simplified), English, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, and Spanish, facilitating global usability.
